name: Kitayori no Senaka
source:
They could live like this forever. But in their heart, it felt wrong.
Too tender and shy to say the words face to face... they're spoken to one's back. True feelings.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ139324.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
